## 💡 Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of what feature or enhancement you are proposing.

## 🎯 Problem Statement / Motivation
Is your feature request related to a problem or business requirement? Please describe (e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]").

## 🛠 Proposed Solution
Describe how you envision this feature working and any specific UI/UX or architectural ideas.

## 🔍 Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## 📌 Additional Context
Add any other context, wireframes, or screenshots about the feature request here.
